# Backend Requests — Frontend Integration Gaps

This document lists backend endpoints the frontend needs, their current status,
and assumed request/response shapes. For the backend teammate.

Generated: 2026-11-04

## Chat page (src/pages/ChatPage.jsx, src/services/chatService.js)

### TEMPORARY: session_id generated by frontend

The chat live adapter (`chatService.js:77`) generates `session_id` via
`crypto.randomUUID()` because `POST /conversations` returns 501 and cannot
provide a backend-owned session. This UUID is sent as `session_id` to
`POST /api/v1/agents/chat` (api.js:182-185).

**This is a TEMPORARY workaround.** Once the backend implements
`POST /conversations`, the backend should generate and own `session_id`,
bind it to the authenticated user + PO + task, and the frontend should
stop generating it. See CHAT_INTEGRATION.md gap #4.

### Endpoints called by chat live adapter

| Method | Path | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | /agents/chat | IMPLEMENTED | Backend proxies to Agent. Request: `{task, reference_id, session_id, question}`. Response: agent contract shape. |
| POST | /conversations | 501 | Assumed: `{task, reference_id}` → `{id, task, reference_id, session_id, created_at}` |
| GET | /conversations/{id}/messages | 501 | Assumed: `{messages: [{id, role, content, status, verified_result, precheck, tool_trace, requires_approval, approval_id, error, notice, created_at}]}` |
| POST | /conversations/{id}/messages | 501 | Assumed: `{question}` → assistant message object (MUST include `id`) |
| POST | /messages/{id}/feedback | 501 | Assumed: `{rating: "up"|"down"}` → `{id, rating}` |
| POST | /approvals/{id}/approve | 501 | Assumed: `{}` → `{id, status: "approved"}` |
| POST | /approvals/{id}/reject | 501 | Assumed: `{}` → `{id, status: "rejected"}` |

### Known gaps (from CHAT_INTEGRATION.md)

1. Message ID: POST /conversations/{id}/messages response MUST include `id` for feedback.
2. Approval ID: agent response has no `approval_id`. Backend must generate/map it.
3. Session binding: backend must bind `session_id` to user + PO + task.
4. Conversation-per-PO: backend must enforce one task + one reference_id per conversation.

## Negotiation Copilot page (src/pages/NegotiationPage.jsx, src/services/negotiationService.js)

Controlled by `VITE_NEGOTIATION_MODE=mock|live` (default: mock).

| Method | Path | Status | Assumed Request | Assumed Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | /negotiations | 501 | (none) | `[{id, supplier_name, purchase_order_id, strategy, target_price, status, created_at}]` |
| POST | /negotiations | 501 | `{purchase_order_id, supplier_id, strategy, target_price}` | `{id, status}` |
| POST | /negotiations/{id}/options | 501 | `{offered_price, target_price, requested_quantity, proposed_delivery_date, preferred_delivery_date, supplier_id}` | `{historical_average, offer_difference, offer_difference_percent, potential_savings, recommendation, approach, confidence, reasons: []}` |
| POST | /negotiations/{id}/drafts | 501 | `{strategy, tone, language, offered_price, target_price, requested_quantity, supplier_id, notes}` | `{draft_text: "..."}` |
| GET | /purchase-orders/{id} | 501 | (none) | PO detail object |
| GET | /vendors/{id}/performance | 501 | (none) | Supplier performance metrics |
| GET | /price-history | 501 | `?po_id=...` or `?product_id=...` | `[{date, unit_price}]` |
| GET | /purchase-history | 501 | `?supplier_id=...` | Historical purchase records |

## Fraud Detection page (src/pages/FraudDetectionPage.jsx, src/services/fraudDetectionService.js)

Controlled by `VITE_FRAUD_MODE=mock|live` (default: mock).

| Method | Path | Status | Assumed Request | Assumed Response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | /fraud/alerts | 501 | (none) | `[{id, transaction_id, invoice_id, supplier_name, anomaly_type, amount, risk_score, severity, detected_at, status, explanation: [], evidence: [], risk_factors: [], recommended_actions: [], audit_trail: []}]` |
| GET | /fraud/alerts/{id} | 501 | (none) | Single alert detail (same shape as above) |
| PATCH | /fraud/alerts/{id} | 501 | `{status: "..."}` | `{id, status}` |
| POST | /fraud/alerts/{id}/explain | 501 | `{action: "...", notes: "...", previous_status: "...", new_status: "..."}` | `{id, timestamp, actor, action, previous_status, new_status, notes}` |
| GET | /fraud/dashboard | 501 | (none) | `{transactions_analyzed, suspicious_transactions, high_risk_suppliers, potential_exposure, trend: [], distribution: []}` |
| POST | /fraud/scans | 501 | `{reference_id, reference_type: "po"\|"supplier"}` | Scan result or job status |
| POST | /fraud/alerts/{id}/hold-payment | 501 | `{reason: "..."}` | Hold confirmation |
| GET | /fraud/rules | 501 | (none) | Active fraud rules list |
| (none) | /fraud/trend | NO-ENDPOINT | Needed for risk trend chart if not in /fraud/dashboard | `[{date, alerts}]` |
| (none) | /fraud/distribution | NO-ENDPOINT | Needed for anomaly distribution chart if not in /fraud/dashboard | `[{type, count, color}]` |
